solution_summary: Nordomatic, a Microsoft-focused organization in Sweden, modernized this customer service automation workload with Dynamics 365 Finance, Power BI, Power Apps, Dynamics 365 Sales, and Microsoft Copilot. Leadership understood that the company had to unify and streamline its systems and reduce manual tasks for more efficiency, to keep up productivity. Dynamics 365 Finance standardizes finance, accounting, and operational processes on one business platform. Power BI publishes dashboards and self-service analytics so business users can act on fresher insights. Power Apps delivers low-code applications tailored to frontline or business-process use cases. Nordomatic connects warehouse systems into Microsoft 365 services, grounds responses through Power BI, and serves generated answers and drafts back to users through Dynamics 365 Finance. Nordomatic builds a smarter future with Dynamics 365.

Nordomatic, headquartered in Stockholm, is the leading independent Building Management System (BMS) integrator in Scandinavia. More than 900 employees in 20 offices provide the world’s largest and most demanding real estate owners with smart building technologies, from security and privacy equipment to heating, cooling, and lighting systems. Nordomatic has been a pioneering and innovative company since its founding in 1967. Reinforcing the company’s mission to accelerate an open and sustainable future, Ola Reppling, COO, says, “My mantra is ‘Rigidity at the core and flexibility at the edge,’ meaning maintaining a solid foundation while adapting to evolving circumstances is the key to deliver value for Nordomatic and our customers now and going forward.”

In 2010, Nordomatic recognized—and acted on—the opportunity for significant expansion throughout Sweden. Five years later, the company was serving major metropolitan areas in Denmark, Norway, The Netherlands, and the United Kingdom, with average annual growth 20% higher than in the previous decade. Today, Nordomatic’s Building Management Services connects 1 million smart assets.

The benefits didn’t stop there. Nordomatic’s team in Sweden is reaping the rewards of the company’s new financial management system. Automation is the biggest efficiency builder, and finance teams quickly came to rely on the simplified accounting process in Dynamics 365 Finance that makes General Ledger entries, reconciles bank records, and makes month-end reporting tasks easier. “We have over 25 thousand transactions per month in Sweden that Dynamics 365 has helped us move from significant manual handling to automated processing”, says Johan Rönström, Finance Director, Nordomatic, Sweden. With fast, flexible custom report generation, managers trust their data to tell the real business health story.

Nordomatic builds a smarter future with Dynamics 365

Nordomatic selected Dynamics 365 Finance, Project Operations, and Supply Chain Management to connect its core business systems on a single, cloud-based platform. The implementation would harmonize the company’s disparate processes and align financial and customer data, offering accessibility to customer service information in real time. Finance teams would benefit from newly streamlined monthly reconciliation and reporting processes while gaining deeper insights into the company’s financial health.
AI-driven, low-code/no-code Power Apps will automate even more business processes, furthering efficiency and ensuring accuracy in daily tasks—all without special coding or IT maintenance.
